keySentence: There is no place like home.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy clicked her shoes. She was back in Kansas. She hugged Aunt Em. There is no place like home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy clicked her silver shoes together three times. Everything spun around her like a whirlwind. When she opened her eyes, she was back on the farm. There is no place like home, Dorothy said with happy tears. Aunt Em ran to her and they hugged each other tightly. Dorothy knew she would never take her home for granted again.
